questions.question: How does Hosea 11 describe God's love for Israel?
options: As a stranger who passed by and showed no concern at all
As a stern king who demanded much service from all his lowly slaves
As an enemy who sought to destroy them in his anger
As a father who loved his child and called his son out of Egypt
questions.answer: As a father who loved his child and called his son out of Egypt

questions.question: What does God say about his compassion in Hosea 11?
options: His heart recoils; his compassion grows warm; he will not destroy Ephraim
His anger burns hot against them; he will cast them all off forever
He waits in patient silence until they at last repent of all their sins
He turns himself away from them and hides his face entirely from them
questions.answer: His heart recoils; his compassion grows warm; he will not destroy Ephraim

questions.question: Hosea 11 pictures God teaching Ephraim to walk, taking them up by their arms.
When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my _____.
How can I give you up, O _____? My heart recoils within me.
